summary: Post-department transfer caused loss of console role entitlements for multiple users
description:
Issue summary:
A set of users who completed a department transfer on 2026-03-11 lost assigned console roles (customer-Dedicated-admin, support-oncall) and no longer see Dedicated dashboards or internal billing views. This appears correlated with an HR-to-Okta sync that changed department attributes.

Impact:
- ~7 users in Prod (us-east) lost role-based access to Dedicated customer dashboards and some org-level console pages.
- Affected users are primarily engineers and platform oncall; blocking day-to-day troubleshooting and incident response.

Environment:
- Prod | us-east, Redwood Console (SAML via Okta), SCIM provisioning pipeline from HR system to Okta.
- Roles are granted via Okta group membership; groups are evaluated by mapping rules that depend on the Okta user attribute `department`.

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1) HR transfer event processed for user (hr_id 39872) on 2026-03-11 03:22 UTC.
2) HR system pushed delta to SCIM provisioning service.
3) Okta SCIM logs show a subsequent "updateUser" event where `department` was set to an empty string for the affected user.
4) Okta Group Rules re-evaluated; user removed from several role groups (removeUserFromGroup events in Okta System Log).
5) Console RBAC sync consumed Okta group change and removed console roles; users lost access.

Observed logs/snippets:
- Okta System Log (user: j.santos): `2026-03-11T03:23:14Z update_user department="" ruleEvaluation=success`
- SCIM provisioning: `200 OK - processed delta for user hr_id=39872; changes: department=null`
- Console audit: `role_removal: user=j.santos roles=[customer-Dedicated-admin, support-oncall] origin=okta-sync`
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12 10:15 - Initial triage by Support: confirmed symptom and gathered Okta system logs and SCIM provisioning logs.
2026-03-12 13:02 - Observed consistent pattern: department attribute cleared for all affected users shortly after HR transfer event.
2026-03-12 15:40 - Replayed SCIM delta in staging: SCIM importer returns department=null when HR payload omits department field. This triggers Okta expression rules to drop group membership.

Hypothesis: HR feed occasionally omits department for department-change cases, and our SCIM importer interprets missing field as explicit empty value and writes it into Okta, causing groups that depend on `department` to be removed.
Checked syncer service (svc-user-sync) logs: multiple entries show `patchUser` calls with payload `{"profile":{"department":""}}` instead of ignoring missing attribute.
No evidence of malicious activity; change aligned with scheduled daily HR delta at 03:20 UTC.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-12 10:22: Collected affected users list and Okta/SCIM logs; escalating to identity team.
Diego Alvarez (Identity) 2026-03-12 11:05: Confirmed Okta events; setting up isolated repro in staging and notifying infra devs. Assigned INT-12817 to identity team.
SRE (Lina Patel) 2026-03-12 16:01: Ran a quick remediation script to re-add explicit group memberships for 5/7 users to restore access temporarily. Logged actions to audit trail.
Identity (Diego) 2026-03-13 09:30: Created PR to make SCIM importer ignore null/empty attributes for department and location fields (see related_github_prs). Waiting code review and canary deploy.

HR Tools (Aaron Bloom) 2026-03-13 11:12: Noted that the HR payload generator has an intermittent bug when department is not provided during transfers. Will add a pass to preserve existing attribute if omitted.

Support (Maya) 2026-03-13 14:45: Communicated temporary workaround to affected users: request admin to reapply roles or run self-remediation flow. Two users confirmed restored access following SRE action.
next_steps: Merge PR to change SCIM importer behavior to ignore empty department attributes and deploy to staging for 24h canary.
Coordinate with HR Tools to fix payload generator so transfers do not emit empty department fields; target deploy 2026-03-16.
Create idempotent remediation script in console microservice to re-evaluate role mappings for users removed in past 48h and reapply roles where appropriate.
Run a one-time backfill for the 7 affected users after fixes are deployed and verify audit trail and Slack channel #internal-support updates.
Document prevention steps in Confluence and add a monitoring rule that alerts if >3 users lose role groups within a 1h window originating from SCIM sync.
resolution_notes: (In progress) Temporary manual role reapplication performed for 5 users by SRE on 2026-03-12. Code fix PR opened to prevent SCIM from writing empty department attributes (pending review). Coordination with HR Tools to fix payload generator is accepted with planned deploy 2026-03-16. Final resolution will include code deploy, HR fix, backfill script, and a new monitoring alert.
audit_trail: 2026-03-12T16:01Z - SRE manual remediation applied (script re-added groups for users: j.santos, r.kim, a.cho) - logged in console audit
2026-03-13T11:12Z - HR Tools acknowledged issue and scheduled deploy 2026-03-16
